title: Connect your domain
blurb: Put your Luubu website on your own web address.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Domains & URL Redirects
steps.body: Click **Domains & URL Redirects** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Start
steps.body: Click **Connect a domain** and type your domain, like yourbusiness.co.nz or www.yourbusiness.co.nz.

steps.title: Easy way
steps.body: If your domain provider is supported, click **Continue** and log in to your provider. The records are added for you.

steps.title: Manual way
steps.body: Otherwise click **Add record manually** and copy the records shown into your provider's DNS settings.
steps.tip: Using Cloudflare? Set the records to DNS only, not proxied.

steps.title: Verify
steps.body: Back in Luubu, verify the domain. DNS changes can take up to 24 hours, but usually far less.

steps.title: Link your site
steps.body: Once verified, choose which website or funnel it shows. See **Link a domain to your website**.
